feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-arm64] ImageMagick: Memory Leak in TIFF encoder when an allocation fails
entry.content:
When an allocation fails in the TIFF encoder a small memory leak will occur.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-jfq9-q63x-rc63
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.15.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jfq9-q63x-rc63
